# BSC (Bharat Steel Group) — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary

This corpus is a large mixed bag of call recordings, and only a modest fraction are genuine sales conversations. The majority of calls fall outside scope:
- Pure internal/operations chatter: cutting-machine (G2/coil) operators coordinating diagonal/thickness checks, loading, stickers, printing, "vandi" (vehicle) scheduling between the shop floor and supervisors (Yuvraj Operator series).
- Transport/logistics negotiation with lorry/trailer brokers (Dushyant/Vizag transporters, V R Earth Movers, Vel Murugan Eng freight quotes).
- Personal/unrelated calls (Vishal's Hindi/Gujarati personal calls, cricket, family chat, wrong numbers, voicemails) — not business-relevant at all.
- Payment-reconciliation/account disputes (debit note, loading/handling charge disputes, UTR/payment-slip arguments) — useful for a narrow "charges objection" pattern but not core selling.

The **real sales calls** that remain are mostly B2B enquiries from fabricators, engineers, contractors, traders and distributors calling BSC for **rate quotes, stock availability, cutting/size customization, quotation follow-up, and order/dispatch confirmation**. Recurring counterparties include Sridhar/Sivakesava Engineers, Vasanth Narasimhan Engg, Vinayaga Steel Pradeep, Vidveda Krishnasamy, Vijayalakshmi Builder, Zetwork Harish, Vijaya Steels Vijayawada, VJR Developers, VASUDEVAN K, Vanniar Narendrakumar, Yuvaraj Elumalai, and a few others. Given the dominance of non-sales chatter, **this KB is built strictly from the surviving genuine sales/enquiry snippets**, and conclusions should be read as directionally useful rather than exhaustive.

## Products & brand ladder

From actual customer requests, BSC deals in long/flat steel products — **not roofing**:

- **TMT Bars / Rods**: FE 500, 500D, 550D grades discussed. Customer told "500 கிடைக்காது... 500 வெறும் R&L தான் produce பண்ணுவாங்க" [500 is only made by R&L/RINL] — so **550D/500D** is what's generally available; 550 "வராது" [won't come] in CRS category.
- **CRS (Cold Rolled/Sale category TMT)** — Vaisakh/Sail brands mentioned; sale-category TMT comes only in 500D ("sale-ல 500D தான் வரும் CRS-ல").
- **MS Plates** (checkered & normal) — thicknesses 2mm, 2.5mm, 3mm, 4mm, 5mm, 6mm, 8mm, 10mm, 12mm, 16mm, 20mm, 25mm, 45mm; standard sheet sizes like 4x8, 8x4, 20x4, 2500x6300mm ("2500, 6300 தான் sir வரும்"); coil-cut-to-plate service exists but minimum/standard sizes apply.
- **Structural steel**: ISMB (I-beams), ISMC/Channel, Angles (L-angle, equal angles e.g. 90x90, 100x100x8/12), Flats (various sizes, e.g. 250mm, 150x75 IBM), SHS/square & rectangular pipe (explicitly **not dealt** — "SHS நம்ம deal பண்றது இல்ல sir... Only ISMB plate").
- **CR (Cold Rolled) Coil/Sheet** — customer request for 0.6mm CR IS 513 sourced via "தெரிஞ்சவர்" [known contact/vendor network], not direct stock.
- **Brands referenced**: Vizag (RINL), JSW, Sail/Vaisakh, NMDC (plates, E250 grade), Tata — company resells/distributes multiple mill brands and quotes "Vizag," "Sail," comparative mill rates.
- Not dealt: CHS pipes ("நம்ம deal பண்றது இல்ல Ma'am, வெளிய இருந்து source பண்ணுவீங்க"), tubes, SHS.

## Real rates & terms (only rates that actually appear in the calls)

- MS Plate 6mm, 8x4 size: **₹66–67 + GST**, loading/transport extra ("+ GST. loading transport எல்லாமே extra").
- MS Plate general (various thickness) market talk: **₹61–64/kg** range quoted in several Vinayaga Steel Pradeep calls (₹61, ₹61.5, ₹62, ₹63, ₹63.5, ₹64 depending on thickness/date); negotiation for ₹500/₹1000 reduction is common but often refused ("rate correct-ஆ தான் இருக்கு sir").
- TMT 12mm & 16mm (Saveetha Institute order, 40 ton): **₹69 (12mm)**, discount to **₹68.5 (16mm)**, "GST extra extra" — explicit "12 கம்மி பண்ண முடியாது... 16mm வந்து 500 கிடைக்கும்" [16mm can get ₹500 off, 12mm cannot].
- TMT/Structural general range (multiple calls, Oct–Nov): **₹62–67 + tax**, e.g. "TMT எல்லாம் 62, 63... Structural plate-லாம் 65, 66."
- Vizag rate quotes: **₹65,000–₹69,000/ton** bracket depending on size (16-25mm ₹65k; 12mm ₹67k; 10mm ₹68-69k; 8mm ₹70k) — "material இன்னும் வரல... அதுக்காக தான் இந்த rate."
- 20mm CRS sale: **₹69,000** (including plus loading, but loading offered free in one case).
- Structural quote example (Vignesh): 8mm **₹67+tax**, 10mm **₹66+tax**, 12-32mm **₹63+tax**.
- Transport/freight examples (not product rate but quoted in sales-adjacent calls): Trichy–Tuticorin ₹1800 (15-16 ton), Gudur AP ₹18/ton (10 ton order), Raichur–Chennai ₹2100-2150, Hyderabad similar, Vizag plant ₹2050.
- Payment/charges: "Payment charge ₹200 standard" (handling/payment recharge per vehicle), disputed when raised to ₹250.
- Credit terms: 1-month credit mentioned once ("Credit-ல 1 month தான்") vs advance payment customers getting better rate than credit customers.
- Cash & Carry pricing explicitly firm — one rep refused to discount cash-and-carry quote despite customer pressure ("Cash and Carry தான் நான் எல்லாருக்குமே கொடுத்துருக்கேன்").

## Objection Playbook

**1. "Rate குறைக்கணும்" (please reduce rate) — standard refusal with firmness**
- Customer: "வேற ஒரு ₹60 rate கொஞ்சம் குறைக்க கூடாதா?"
- Rep: "இல்லை sir, loading charges கூட கம்மி பண்ண முடியாது sir." Hold the line, cite "rate correct-ஆ இருக்கு sir," redirect to volume/urgency instead of price.

**2. "நீங்க always ₹200 போடுறீங்க, இப்போ ஏன் ₹250?" (sudden charge increase dispute)**
- Acknowledge: "அது தெரியாம by mistake-ஆ பண்ணிட்டு இருக்கோம்." Offer a concrete fix: "நான் debit note raise பண்ணிடுறேன்... நீங்க credit note raise பண்ணிருங்க." Keep tone calm even when customer escalates to "உங்க MD கிட்ட பேசினோம்."

**3. "Competitive price இல்லைன்னா order-ஏ கைவிட்டு போயிடுது" (dealer/distributor price pressure)**
- Distributor: "என்னதான் negotiate பண்ணாலும் இந்த rate-க்கு கீழ போக மாட்டாங்க... customer-க்கு கொடுக்குறேன் Madam, அவங்களுக்கு அந்த rate-ஓ வந்தா தானே order-ஏ place பண்றாங்க."
- Rep response pattern: acknowledge constraint, commit to "main item" leads only, promise faster turnaround ("கொஞ்சம் சீக்கிரம் மட்டும் குடுத்துருங்க").

**4. Market volatility objection ("rate ஏறி கொண்டே இருக்கு, இன்னைக்கு வாங்கணுமா?")**
- Good coaching example (Vasanth Narasimhan calls): advise customer to buy **limited/urgent quantity only**, not bulk, during high-price periods: "Limited stock வாங்குங்க... rate-லாம் ரொம்ப high இருக்கு... emergency-க்கு மட்டும்." This builds trust over pure upsell.

**5. Stock/size unavailability objection**
- Be transparent about exact available sizes rather than overpromising: "2.5-க்கு 5 meter-ல ஒரு plate இருக்கு sir" instead of claiming full range; offer to "yard-ல check பண்ணிட்டு சொல்றேன்."

**6. Delivery delay / urgency pushback**
- Customer: "இது உடனே பண்ண முடியாது Sir. நிறைய program-லாம் இருக்கு." Set expectation clearly with a specific day/half ("Thursday தான்"), avoid vague promises.

**7. Documentation/proof disputes (payment slip, photo, seal)**
- When customer disputes missing proof documents, acknowledge system/camera issues honestly rather than denying: "அன்னைக்கு camera-வும் system-உம் problem Sir." Offer concrete remedy (seal+sign printed copy) to close the loop.

## Effective Lines (openings, discovery, closing, follow-up)

**Openings**
- "Hello sir, Good Afternoon. [Name] பேசுறேன் Sir, [Company]-ல இருந்து." — company + name identification upfront, standard and effective.
- "Sir, இது processor sir... ஏன்னா அப்புறமா எனக்கு late-ஆ சொன்னீங்கன்னா வண்டி கிடைக்காது sir." — creates urgency for the rep to prioritize.

**Discovery**
- "என்ன quantity வேணும் sir?" / "என்ன size வேணும்?" / "Delivery location எங்க sir?" — systematic qualifying questions before quoting.
- "Loading free பண்ணலாம், ஒன்னும் problem இல்ல" — small concession offered proactively to smooth the deal (seen in CRS sample case).
- Confirming brand/grade precisely before quoting: "இது E250 grade-ஆ sir?" — avoids mismatched delivery disputes later.

**Closing**
- "Okay-ன்னா நான் PO அனுப்பிச்சிடுறேன்." — clear next-step commitment line used repeatedly by customers; reps should mirror with "PO வந்த உடனே load பண்றதுக்கு ஏற்பாடு பண்ணிடுறேன்."
